recognize_zh: 中央大型巨噬細胞的淡色泡沫狀細胞質內含多顆被吞噬的有核細胞（深染圓核的淋巴球或紅血球母細胞）及紅血球，是噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）的典型表現。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Multiple engulfed intact nucleated cells with dense round nuclei (lymphocytes/erythroid precursors) within vacuoles
Engulfed red cells and larger nucleated cell fragments also present
Adjacent monocyte, band neutrophil, lymphocytes and eosinophil
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm containing multiple phagocytosed nucleated cells with dense round nuclei, likely lymphocytes and erythroid precursors, as well as erythrocytes. Surrounding cells include a monocyte, a band neutrophil, lymphocytes and an eosinophil. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis, supporting hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Emperipolesis occurs in megakaryocytes with lobulated nuclei and granular cytoplasm, not in a histiocyte with a single oval nucleus.
Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris rather than intact nucleated cells and red cells.
Engulfed cells are surrounded by clear vacuoles within the macrophage cytoplasm rather than lying on top of the cell.
